__comment: PROVISIONED BOARD - edit this file in git, not in the Grafana UI (allowUiUpdates:false). Cost and per-call token panels read Postgres call_costs, which CostTracker.finalize() writes as a true per-call sum; per-TURN token panels read Tempo, because call_costs has no per-turn grain. See backend/DASHBOARDS.md for why each panel uses the source it does and which reference line it is read against.

panels.title: Per-call cost (Postgres call_costs - the authoritative ledger)
Cost per call vs the canon line
panels.description: docs/16 §5 owns the canonical figure: ≈$0.30 (~₹25) per 5-minute call WITH prompt caching, ≈$0.35 without. Both are drawn as threshold bands. IMPORTANT: today's rows cannot reach either line - CostTracker.finalize() hardcodes stt_usd/tts_usd/embeddings_usd to zero (backend/app/agent/cost_tracker.py:261-271, 'Judgment call #6: Phase 2 is text-only'), so total_usd currently carries LLM dialogue + utility ONLY, roughly $0.10 of the $0.30. A low reading here is a MISSING-COMPONENT signal, not an under-budget win. See the 'Cost components' panel below, which makes the zeros visible.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT created_at AS "time", total_usd::float8 AS "total_usd"
FROM call_costs
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
ORDER BY created_at

panels.title: Cost components per call (stacked)
panels.description: The six NUMERIC(10,6) component columns of call_costs, which the ck_call_costs_total_usd CHECK constraint (backend/app/models/orm.py:323-326) forces to sum to total_usd. This panel exists to make the Phase-2 zero-fill obvious: stt_usd, embeddings_usd and tts_usd are written as literal zero by CostTracker.finalize(), and turn_infra_usd is not passed at all (it falls to the column's server_default of 0). docs/16 §5 expects TTS alone to be ~50% of a real call's cost, so a stack that is 100% LLM is the current, known-incomplete state.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT created_at AS "time",
       stt_usd::float8           AS "STT (Deepgram)",
       llm_dialogue_usd::float8  AS "LLM dialogue",
       llm_utility_usd::float8   AS "LLM utility",
       embeddings_usd::float8    AS "Embeddings",
       tts_usd::float8           AS "TTS (ElevenLabs)",
       turn_infra_usd::float8    AS "Turn infra"
FROM call_costs
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
ORDER BY created_at

panels.title: Mean cost per call (USD)
panels.description: Mean of call_costs.total_usd over the dashboard time range. Threshold colours are the docs/16 §5 lines: green under $0.30, orange from $0.30, red from $0.35. Reads low today for the zero-fill reason described on the 'Cost per call' panel.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT avg(total_usd)::float8 AS "mean_usd_per_call"
FROM call_costs
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Mean cost per call (INR)
panels.description: The same mean, shown in rupees for the docs/17 §2.5 exit criterion ('matching the ≈$0.30 (~₹25) canonical figure'). CAVEAT ON THE RATE: no doc in this repo states a USD→INR rate. 83.3333 is DERIVED from docs/16 §5's own paired figures ($0.30 ↔ ₹25) so this panel agrees with canon by construction; it is not a live FX rate and will drift from the market. Change it here and in backend/DASHBOARDS.md together if canon's pairing ever changes.

targets.rawSql:
-- 83.3333 INR/USD is derived from docs/16 §5's $0.30 <-> ₹25 pairing.
SELECT (avg(total_usd) * 83.3333)::float8 AS "mean_inr_per_call"
FROM call_costs
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Calls finalized (window)
panels.description: Row count in call_costs over the range. One row per call, written by CostTracker.finalize() at hang-up. Zero here means no call completed - which is also why every other panel on this board would be empty, so check this first before believing a flat cost line.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*)::float8 AS "calls"
FROM call_costs
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Prompt-cache hit share (per call)
panels.description: cached_input_tokens / input_tokens across the window. docs/16 §5 budgets a ~1,400-token cached prefix against ~2,200 input tokens per invocation (~64%), and values caching at ~$0.06/call (17% of the canonical total). A collapse toward 0% is the single cheapest explanation for a cost panel drifting upward. Source columns are true per-call sums (CostTracker.finalize(), backend/app/agent/cost_tracker.py:268-270).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (sum(cached_input_tokens)::float8
        / NULLIF(sum(input_tokens), 0)::float8) AS "cache_hit_share"
FROM call_costs
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Token budgets (docs/11 §1: ≤2,500 in / ≤150 out per TURN)
Input tokens per turn vs budget
panels.description: Reads the `input_tokens` attribute of the `turn` span (emitted at backend/app/agent/cost_tracker.py:175 onto the span threaded from backend/app/agent/conversation_manager.py:219). Reference lines: 2,450 = docs/11 §1's nine slot budgets summed; 2,500 = the per-turn target; 3,000 = the hard cap that fails the build. READ THIS CAREFULLY: record_turn() fires once per LLM ROUND and re-sets the same key on the same span, so the value is the turn's LAST round, not its total. That is the RIGHT number for a prompt-budget question (the last round carries the most context - tool results have been appended - so it is the turn's largest prompt) and the WRONG number for per-turn token totals. Use the Postgres per-call token panel for totals.

custom.axisLabel: input tokens (last LLM round of the turn)

panels.title: Output tokens per turn vs budget
panels.description: Same `turn` span, `output_tokens` attribute (backend/app/agent/cost_tracker.py:176). Reference line at 150 = docs/11 §1's per-turn output cap. The same last-round caveat as the input panel applies; for output it matters less, because the final round is the one that actually produces the spoken reply.

panels.title: Tokens per CALL (Postgres totals)
panels.description: The per-call totals CostTracker.finalize() sums across every round of every turn (backend/app/agent/cost_tracker.py:268-270) - the figure the per-turn Tempo panels above cannot give. docs/16 §5's canonical call budgets ~44k input / ~1.6k output across ~20 dialogue invocations, so these are call-scale numbers, NOT to be compared against the 2,500/150 per-turn lines.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT created_at AS "time",
       input_tokens::float8        AS "input tokens",
       cached_input_tokens::float8 AS "cached input tokens",
       output_tokens::float8       AS "output tokens"
FROM call_costs
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
ORDER BY created_at

panels.title: Recent turns - tokens, model and cost (raw spans)
panels.description: Plain TraceQL search, so this panel does NOT depend on Tempo's metrics generator - check it first when the two budget graphs above are empty. Rows appearing here with empty graphs above means the metrics-generator config is wrong (infra/docker/tempo/tempo.yaml), not the trace pipeline. Every column is emitted by CostTracker.record_turn(): input_tokens (cost_tracker.py:175), output_tokens (:176), cost_usd (:177), model (:178), cost_estimated (:181, set ONLY when the provider usage frame was incomplete or the served model had no pricing entry - an unflagged row is a priced-from-real-usage row). cost_usd here is ONE LLM ROUND, not the turn or the call; the call total is call_costs.total_usd, shown at the top of this board.

targets.query: { span:name = "turn" && span.input_tokens != nil } | select(span.session_id, span.turn_no, span.model, span.input_tokens, span.output_tokens, span.cost_usd, span.cost_estimated)

title: VyaparPay - Cost & Token Budgets
